prompt:
The collage section in sections/collage-defaults.liquid currently prints its settings as they are, so a merchant who leaves fields empty gets blank headings, empty titles and invalid layout classes. Change the markup so that every field has a sensible default. Keep the {% schema %} block exactly as it is. Inputs. Every input is under `section`: - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.layout: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block has block.settings.title (string or null) and block.settings.caption (string or null). Rules: 1. Heading. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from section.settings.heading. If the value is null or empty after stripping, use the text `Featured collage`. Always output `

HEADING

`, with the stripped heading HTML-escaped. 2. Layout. The layout is `right` only when section.settings.layout is exactly the string `right`. This check is case-sensitive. Any other value, including null, `Right` and `center`, gives `left`. 3. Wrapper. Directly after the h2, output `
`, then its content, then `
`. 4. Items. For each block, in order, output `

TITLE

CAPTION
`: - TITLE is block.settings.title stripped and HTML-escaped. - If the title is null or empty after stripping, TITLE is `Item N`. N is the block's 1-based position in section.blocks, counting every block. - CAPTION is `

TEXT

`, where TEXT is the stripped caption, HTML-escaped. - If the caption is null or empty after stripping, CAPTION is omitted entirely, with no empty

. 5. Empty state. If section.blocks is empty, the wrapper contains only `

Add blocks to build your collage.

`. Formatting. Output no whitespace or newlines between or inside tags, apart from the text itself. Leading and trailing whitespace of the whole output is ignored. HTML-escaping means the standard Liquid escape of & < > " characters. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/collage-defaults.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
